name: whoami
description: Return the staff identity this server acts as: role, nonprofit and permissions.

name: list_participants
description: List participants of your nonprofit, optionally filtered by name or ID.

search.description: Name fragment or exact participant ID
search.title: Search

name: list_funds
description: List your nonprofit's funds with allocation, committed, paid and available amounts.

name: get_funding_summary
description:
Funding summary for one fund (if fund_id is given) or all funds, with totals.
available = allocation - committed (approved, unpaid) - paid.

name: create_request
description:
Submit an assistance request (case_worker only). Starts Pending; does not reserve funds.
Requests cannot be edited after submission.

amount.description: USD amount as a decimal string, e.g. "300.00"
amount.title: Amount

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key; retrying with the same key and payload returns the original request
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

replayed.description: True if an earlier request with the same idempotency_key was returned
replayed.title: Replayed

name: approve_request
description:
Approve a Pending request (program_manager only). Reserves the full amount against its fund;
fails with INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS if the fund's available balance is too low.

name: reject_request
description: Reject a Pending request (program_manager only). Funding is unchanged.

name: record_payment
description:
Record a simulated payment of the full amount for an Approved request (finance only).
Moves the amount from committed to paid; available is unchanged. Succeeds once per request.

name: get_request
description: Get one assistance request of your nonprofit by ID.

name: list_requests
description: List your nonprofit's assistance requests, newest first, with optional filters.
